seed_noise._comment: v4 の必須項目。δ の導出はこの値を**入力に取らない**(FR-029)。

correction.missing: each missing h component contributes0 to exponent; other components remain; normalized p need not stay unchanged
correction.fit: Three coefficients fit jointly on strictly earlier calendar years, per seed,2019 warmup

limitations: Historical selection-used full-information data; no unused holdout or preweight claim.
This tests joint gap-coefficient re-adjustment plus seasonal-sex terms versus old gap-only, not an isolated season effect with gap fixed.
Same-season constants cancel in all-known-female or all-known-nonfemale races; mixed fields identify the seasonal contrast. Unknown sex is a separate diagnostic group.
Each CI uses transferred sd_fold.001816/k_seeds1 and holds correction coefficients fixed; neither joint-vector refit uncertainty nor retained-side gamma uncertainty/selection is fully represented.
Equal seed means average losses, not probabilities. No all-seed/majority/mean-CI rule; deployment seed42 residual risk remains.
No additional booster fit, annual confirmation slot, or production mutation.
research_progression: Retain the seasonal increment only when BOTH anchor and retained equal-seed mean NLL differences are negative with existing quality guards; no individual-seed sign or significance threshold.

seed_mean_rule.individual_BLOCKED: REVIEW_REQUIRED when valid numerical quality evidence exists
seed_mean_rule.invalid_evidence: Missing seeds, invalid numbers, unknown flags or provenance mismatch stop aggregation
